<div class="function-reference" markdown="1">

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`auto now = millis();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-millis) | Read elapsed time in ms; use unsigned subtraction to time actions across clock wraparound. |
| [`auto nowUs = micros();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-micros) | Read elapsed microseconds; both targets have only 1000-microsecond resolution. |
| [`delay(10);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-delay) | Does nothing in studio apps, on the device and in the browser emulator. Use millis() timing instead of pausing. |
| [`delayMicroseconds(100);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-delaymicroseconds) | Does nothing on both targets; use the update loop for timing. |
| [`auto roll = random(1, 7);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-random) | Choose an integer from the first bound inclusive to the second exclusive; one argument starts at 0. |
| [`randomSeed(42);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-randomseed) | Does nothing in studio apps, on the device and in the browser emulator. |
| [`auto brightness = map(value, 0, 100, 0, 255);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-map) | Rescale an integer range; does not clamp values outside the range. |
| [`auto bounded = constrain(value, 0L, 100L);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-constrain) | Clamp a value between inclusive bounds; use long integers on both targets. |
| [`auto smaller = min(a, b);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-min) | Choose the smaller of two values of the same type. |
| [`auto larger = max(a, b);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-max) | Choose the larger of two values of the same type. |
| [`auto angle = radians(90.0f);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-radians) | Convert degrees to radians (one full turn is about 6.283 radians). |
| [`auto angle = degrees(1.0f);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-degrees) | Convert radians to degrees (360 degrees is one full turn). |
| [`millis_NOW`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-millis-now) | The time in ms when this frame started; read it instead of calling millis() repeatedly. |
